scripts.dev: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' --filter '@bilibili-notify/contract' run build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' --filter '@bilibili-notify/contract' --filter '@bilibili-notify/server' --filter '@bilibili-notify/web' --parallel --stream run dev
scripts.build:update-payload: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' --filter '@bilibili-notify/contract' run build && pnpm --filter @bilibili-notify/web --filter @bilibili-notify/server run build:bundle && node scripts/assemble-server-bundle.mjs
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm run build:update-payload && pnpm --filter @bilibili-notify/desktop run dev
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:update-payload && pnpm --filter @bilibili-notify/desktop run tauri:build
